However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1) The Commercial Vehicles hired shall be for departmental use by South Central Railway, Secunder abad on a Regular basis. The Vehicle will be used as per directions given by Dy.CEE/Trd/HQ for official Purpose for a period of 36 months. The base location shall be Hyderabad (Telangana). 2) EVALUATION CRITERION: The tenderer is required to upload the followin g mandatory documents along with the bid offer, failing by which the offer will be summarily rejected. a)AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Servi ce Provider must be located in the state of Telangana for better coordination and service. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. b) DETAILS OF VEHICLE: One Vehicle (Non-AC SUV) should be registered in the name of Tenderer and should not sublet any part of the contract. Howev er, the tenderer can have Lease Agreement with the owner of the vehicle/cab aggregator on non-judicial stamp paper for the tenure of the contract, which s hould be submitted along with the bid. The vehicle proposed to be offered on hire should be in good condition and not more than 4 years old, on the date of opening of tender. The tenderer is required to submit the COMMERCIAL VEHIC LE REGISTRATION DETAILS along with supporting documents of the vehicle ful filling the category, specifications along with the tender, failing to submit the s ame along with the bid, the offer will be summarily rejected. Bids of other tha n commercial vehicles should be summarily rejected. Vehicle should be reg istered in the state of Telangana. If the bidder offers vehicle register ed in the state other than Telangana, then valid RTO permit of plying the vehicle in Telangana or ALL INDIA PERMIT to be mandatorily uplo aded with the bid offer. Bids of commercial vehicles registered in any state other than Telangana state (without valid RTO permit of plying the vehicle in Telangana or ALL INDIA PERMIT) will be summarily rejected. c) PERFORMANCE DETAILS: Along with tender, bidders to enclose the list of ongoing vehicle hire contracts with Railways, Other Central Government Depa rtments, State Government and PSUs in the same city/location/agglomeration with details of Contract Period, rate per month, Vehicle Class, Model and bran d, Fuel (Diesel/Petrol/ LPG/CNG/Electric/Hybrid), procurement cost (ex showro om price) etc. Submission of this statement, even if Nil, shall be mandatory en closure to the tender failing which the offer will be summarily rejected. Annex ure-III should be uploaded with the bid duly signed and stamped by t he bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per document Annexure-III of Buyer uploaded ATC document]. d) Submission of undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents - The bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the

documents submitted / uploaded along with the tender. This shall be mandat ory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder to submit the undertakin g, their offer shall be summarily rejected. Annexure-I should be uploaded with the bid duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per Annexure-I of Buyer uploaded ATC document] e) Declaration of the details of the engagement of Retired/Existing Railway E mployees. Declaration regarding site visit, compliance of statutory laws, penalty for viola tion of labor laws, Non blacklisting, termination of contracts etc. Self declarati on of the undertaking by the bidder that My/our firm/ Company is not under liquidation court receivership or similar proceedings and has not suffered ban kruptcy/insolvency during the last 5 years. Annexure- IV should be upload ed with the bid duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which t he offer will be summarily rejected without making any back referen ce. [Proforma as per Annexure-IV of Buyer uploaded ATC document]. f) CONSTITUTION OF FIRM: The bidder shall give full details of the constituti on of the Firm/Company/Society etc. and shall also submit following document s (as applicable), in addition to documents mentioned above. (i) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized copy o f the affidavit or GST certificate indicating Proprietorship certificate. (ii) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i) re gistered/notarized Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly auth orising one or more of the partners of the firm or any other persons(s), a uthorised by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign Measure ment Books, receive payment, make correspondences, compromise/sett le/ relinquish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certifica te', refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar action in res pect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (iii) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall su bmit (i) the copies of MOA (Memorandum of Association) and AOA (Articl es of Association) of the Company; and (ii) Power of Attorney duly regist ered/notarized by the company (backed by the resolution of Board of Dir ectors) in favour of the individual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Comp any. (iv) Society: The bidder shall submit (i) Self- attested copy of the certific ate of Registration, (ii) Deed of Formation and (iii) Power of Attorney in f avour of the tender signatory.

(v) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture ( JV) not permitted /not allowed in thi s tender Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certific ates / documents sought in the Bid document. Post tender opening no new documents will be considered for bid ev aluation even at representation stage. 3) The contractor/agency participating in the tender should normally be GST c ompliant regarding registration, filing of returns etc., and shall be fully respon sible for the compliance as per GST Act at all times. If the Contractor falls eith er “below the turnover threshold for GST” or is a “Composition Taxable Person ” under the CGST Act, a self-declaration should be enclosed with his offer duly supported by a certificate of turnover from a Chartered Accountant or enclose Form ‘REG-06’ showing as “Composition” under Type of Registration and no G ST is applicable for contracts with such persons/firms. GST for vehicle rental/hi re services falls under SAC code 9966, as per which, the present applicable rate is 5% (2.5% CGST+2.5% SGST) for vehicles designed to carry men a nd materials where cost of fuel is included in the rate. 4) Once the contract is awarded, the service provider needs to submit Driver’s details to the consignee and driver should have passed a minimum of 10th sta ndard and possess a valid driving licence, Aadhar Card on his name and empl oyee identification card issued by the Contractor at all times. The verification of driver details, Driving license, Aadhar Card etc.. has to be done by consigne e. 5) The vehicle’s should be available on all days including holidays as per requi rement of the user for official duty. 6) In reference to SLA clause no.5.11 and 5.12, the substitute vehicle’s offered shall not be older than the vehicle under breakdown at any point of time durin g the currency of contract. The condition and upkeep of substitute vehicle shal l be same as that of approved vehicle’s in the contract. 7) The contractor shall be responsible for providing the vehicles at any point of time in day or night, eve n at short notice during any urgency/emergency. Hiring for 12 hours in a day means continuous hiring f or 12 hours during day or 12 hours during night. No advance payment shall be made and all payments r eleased on completion of stipulated service periodically/monthly as stipulated. In case, on any day, the vehicle was utilised for more than 12 hours on exceptional/ emergency requirement, relaxation to that e xtent may be provided in subsequent days to the Contractor/firm. 8) Imposition of penalties is as per Para 8 of GeM SLA.

9) The SLA clause 4.2 sub clause (1) & (2) for payment of extra kilo meter and extra hours shall not be applicable to this contract. In any month, vehicle run can be more or less than the scale of Number of 20 00KM/month but shall not exceed cumulative KM 24,000 per year for SUV A/C and Sedan Non A/C vehicl es and for SUV non A/C vehicle the scale of Number of 2500KM/month but shall not exceed cumulative K M 30,000 per year. Payment will be made on a monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KM run in that month. No further variation in KM is either allowed or to be paid. The rate quote d shall be inclusive of salary of driver, daily batta, fuel, petrol/diesel, other consumables, regular mainte nance, expenses and other expenditure towards repairs, taxes etc. 10) Price variation Clause is not applicable in this tender. 11) A Log Book for each vehicle shall be maintained by the Contractor for the hired vehicles. The KM utilised shall be entered in it on a daily basis to ensure proper account and payment at the end of every month/specified period. It is t he responsibility of the official using the vehicle to keep the log book up to dat e and the vehicle is used for the official duties/works. Statement of entries as per Log Book should be enclosed with the bills submitted for payment by the s ervice provider/contractor duly counter signed by the official to who/under wh ose custody the vehicle is placed except that in case of vehicles hired for DRM s/PHODs/AGM/GM, this statement shall be countersigned by nominated officer in the secretariat. In case of pooled vehicles, Secretary to PHOD or ADRM or n ominated in charge Gazetted Officer will sign the Log Book/statement sent wit h bills thereof, as the case may be. 12) The vehicle contract can be short-closed with three months notice, if the post of the officer is surren dered or the officer opts for drawl of transport allowance or any other administrative reason (except uns atisfactory service, which will be as per penalty clause of SLA). In this regard, the following conditions wi ll be applicable: The Railway has liberty to short-close the contract with any or all of the service providers normally with t hree months' notice without assigning any reason. However, in case a service provider wants to short cl ose his services, he will have to serve 4 months advance written notice. a. The contract for the vehicles hired can also be terminated with a short notice of 15 days on acco unt of unsatisfactory services at the discretion of the Officer in charge of hiring of vehicles. The unsatisfa ctory service shall mean and include the non-compliance of any of the obligations by the service provide r, as given in this agreement and/or under the penalty clauses of the SLA of GeM contract or repeated br each. PG of the service provider will be forfeited in the case of breach of SLA where the brea ch is not capable of remedy and the contract is terminated. b. In case of any dispute of any kind, the Contractor/ Agency shall abide by the decision of the contr olling authority or Nodal Officer or Buyer in charge of hiring of the vehicle as the case may be.

13) Successful Bidders have to submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt /Performance bank Guarantee (Bank Guarantee sam ple format as per Annexure-II of scope of work document). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/SC (Name of the Service Provider ). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, t he FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the buyer after making endorse ment on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with a covering l etter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in p lace of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the buy er within 30 days of award of bid in GeM/date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security. GeM contract will be issued only after receipt of Perfor mance Security. Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 days and u p to the date of submission of PG from the date of issue of intimation to deposi t Performance Security may be given by Dy.CEE/TRD/HQ However, a penal int erest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the delay beyond 30 days (i.e fro m 31st day after the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Securit y. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG after 60 days from th e date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security, a notice shall be served to the contractor to deposit PG immediately however not exceeding 90 days from date of intimation. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisit e PG even after 90 days from the date of intimation, a notice shall be served t o the contractor and the GeM Bid shall be cancelled duly forfeiting EMD and ot her dues, if any payable against the tender. The failed Service Provider shall be debarred from participating in re-tender for that service. In case, 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure next working day should be considered as t he last day for submission of PGs, Decision of Dy.CEE/TRD/HQ would be final i n case of any dispute. 14) (a) The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaini ng the prior written consent of buyer (b) The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer. (c) The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract , remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to the buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 15) The Service provider having non-satisfactory/bad performance in previously completed contracts or current live contracts may be rejected. 16) The vehicle documents which were uploaded in the bidding process shoul d be kept in service along with the Number, Model and type of vehicle’s after approval of consignee. In case ,the condition of vehicle’s is not satisfactory or require replacement due to any other reason , service provider has to replace the vehicle’s with same segment or higher segment commercial vehicle’s, me ntioned in GeM SLA, as per bid conditions with approval of user/consignee.

17) The vehicle’s should be available every day at nominated time and place as per the directions of Dy.CEE/Trd/HQ given from time to time. Vehicles shall/ Can be parked in the Railway premises/Residence during night time for emerg ency use as per direction of Dy.CEE/Trd/HQ the Vehicle keys should be submitt ed to the officer/authorize representative after duty hours, in case any emerg ency officer can use the vehicle. Minimum 30% of fuel tank capacity should be in the vehicle all the time. In case of any dispute, the decision of Dy.CEE/TRD/ HQ shall be binding regarding placement and usage of vehicle for contractor. 18) The bills will be submitted through the GeM Portal by Seller. The Seller has to prepare a draft Seller Invoice and submit it to the Consignee for verification and levy of penalty, if any. After verification of Consignee, Seller shall generat e final Seller invoice with penalty (if any) and upload/attach copy of Log Book, Penalty advice from Consignee, Fund certification from Consignee etc with fin al Seller invoice and finally generate GeM Seller Invoice. The Consignee shall e nsure generation of Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate (SDAC) and verify the penalty etc, if any. If the invoice generated by Seller, mismatches with co ntract/ the amount of penalty imposed / document stated above, the Consigne e shall return the Seller GeM invoice in GeM itself suggesting the corrections. I f the Seller GeM invoice and Seller Invoice is correct, then, SDAC shall be gene rated within 7 working days from the date of GeM seller invoice date, else Ge M will auto-generate SDAC and populate the bill to Buyer for forwarding to Pay ing authority. The Bill Passing officer is Consignee indicated in the contrac t and the Bill Paying Officer is PFA/SCR. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
